title: Extensibility

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Keep a central promise recognizable while changing its verb so different kinds of contributors can see themselves in the message.
strategic_value: A replaceable action word can extend Figma’s teamwork story beyond a single creative discipline.
demonstration: Orange annotations isolate MADE in the white sentence; a vertical column supplies colored alternative verbs above and below it.
practical_value: Identify which part of a campaign line can vary without losing its central idea.

content_islands.name: Sentence frame
content_islands.spec: Place the fixed white words across the black field and leave a wide slot for the verb.

content_islands.name: Verb column
content_islands.spec: Stack actions through the slot, cropped at the upper and lower edges.

content_islands.name: Annotations
content_islands.spec: Bracket MADE and mark vertical extension with orange arrows.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent Extensibility description explains adding future modules without losing coherence.
reference_purposes.Application: The orange bracket identifies a replaceable verb within the repeated sentence.
reference_purposes.Expression: Colored verbs interrupt a white campaign line on black.

ingredient.name: Replaceable campaign verb
ingredient.role: Invite different creative roles into one promise.
ingredient.application: Keep the surrounding sentence stable while substituting a relevant action word.
ingredient.scope: Observed campaign mechanism; the board does not prescribe an exhaustive verb list or universal typography rule.
